about: v1: orchestra-gentle-human as it is (the flute on the tune in the intro and the first verse, the violins in the others, the harp breathing with each phrase, violas and cellos under it, basses plucked then bowed, a flute descant over the last verse, which rises only a little (build 0.4); the carol's own 120 bpm, three verses, the 2.4 s hall), its calm ending kept as the user chose it for this style: every held part dying away over the last chord, the harp falling into the deep tonic, about 4 s, already short where Piano nỉ's long ending was not. The violins and the harp sit nearer the middle (-0.2, from -0.35 and -0.3): with the violins on the tune at the left, the piece leaned 1.2 dB left (the channel's checks: 1 dB at most) once its lows were made alike on both sides; remixed from its parts, 0.3 dB. sfizz is mended (sampled.yml).
